item.title: Tesla Cybercab Debut: Steering‑Free Robotaxi Launch
item.description: Tesla's Austin event unveils the Cybercab, a steering‑wheel‑free robotaxi that relies solely on cameras, marking a pivotal shift toward autonomous ride‑hail services.
